text:
lina_s: FYI found what looks like a Vault staging token in partner-ci logs from yesterday. It was in a verbose debug dump from a third-party step. Not sure if it was exfiltrated but we should treat as compromised.

omar.c: ugh. can you paste the log line (sanitized) and where it was stored?

lina_s: pasted excerpt (sanitized):
```
2026-03-18T21:11:02Z DEBUG partner-step: requesting secret from vault: token=va.Bq9...REDACTED...mQZ
```
Stored in GCS bucket: gs://thirdparty-ci-logs/partner/build-20260318/logs/debug.log (ACL: partner-ci-readonly).

sec-bot: automatic detection: potential-seed-token-exposure (severity: high). Creating incident SEC-1433.

eva-g: immediate steps: 1) revoke token and any derived leases; 2) rotate staging auth keys; 3) scan logs/archives for copies; 4) update RBAC and CI steps to stop printing tokens. Who can revoke the token? @mike-se?

mike-se: I can revoke. Which vault path and token id?

lina_s: token id: va.Bq9xxxx (full id in secure incident ticket only). The token was used against staging-vault in project infra-staging.

mike-se: revoking now. `vault token revoke -id va.Bq9xxxx` -> success. Also listing active leases for that token to revoke child tokens.

eva-g: good. I'll schedule a rotation for the staging auth keys and wrap keys. ETA 45m. We should hold non-critical deploys until rotation completes. @oncall-rota can you pause scheduled deploys for staging?

oncall-rota: pausing non-critical deploys. Notifying infra oncall.

omar.c: scanning for leaked tokens in GCS and artifacts:
```bash
gsutil cat gs://thirdparty-ci-logs/partner/build-20260318/logs/debug.log | grep -E "vault.*token|va\.[A-Za-z0-9]+" -n
# search older archives
for f in $(gsutil ls gs://thirdparty-ci-logs/**); do gsutil cat $f | grep -q "va." && echo $f; done
```
Found 2 archived files containing token strings (same build). Tagging them in SEC-1433.

somebody: quick question  did partner have long-lived service account creds mounted?

lina_s: partner runner used a short-lived CI job token but their step printed the Vault token returned by our API. Their runner logs are public to their org; we need to notify them about log retention and ask to rotate on their side too.

eva-g: opening PR to disallow printing secret values in our client library wrappers. Also adding a test to fail CI when `DEBUG` prints token patterns. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-client/pull/780 (WIP).

mike-se: rotation plan (staging): 1) rewrap vault wrap keys; 2) rotate staging service tokens; 3) issue new short-lived tokens to integrations; 4) invalidate old leases. Doing step 1 now.

(10m later)
mike-se: rewrap completed, service tokens rotated, new tokens issued to infra services. I pushed new creds to staging secrets and updated the deployer.

omar.c: still scanning partner artifact buckets and internal backups for token strings. Found 1 backup snapshot from Feb with a token copy; adding to ticket.

eva-g: notifying partner security contact: "We detected Vault token printed in your CI logs. We revoked the token and rotated keys on our side. Please rotate any credentials on your side that may have used the token and remove the logs. We'll share safe-remediation steps."

sec-bot: external notification sent to partner (redacted) and added follow-up task: ensure partner deletes retained logs.

lina_s: add runbook item: CI steps must never print token-like patterns. Also add an infra lint check that fails if `printf`/`echo` prints env var names matching VA_* or VAULT_TOKEN.

eva-g: PR opened for lint rule and library change. Linking in SEC-1433.

mike-se: post-rotation monitoring: enabling extra audit logging for staging-vault for 72h and adding alert for any `vault.token.create` events that look unusual.

omar.c: search complete. I pushed a purge list to SEC-1433 with object names to request deletion from partner bucket (they'll need to delete on their side). Also flagged internal backup for manual scrub.

oncall-rota: monitoring live. If partner confirms deletion we'll close the external exposure thread.

lina_s: remaining action items: - close partner confirmation loop - add lint + client PRs - update RBAC so `vault:token` prints are blocked in debug - postmortem short note and update runbook.

eva-g: assigning follow-ups and ETA EOD. I'll mark SEC-1433 P1 and draft the postmortem template.

mike-se: thumbs for coordination.

(End of thread)
